scripts.check:static: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && node scripts/check-static.mjs
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.dry-run:staging: npm run build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run
scripts.dry-run:production: npm run build:production && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run
